column1: # tools/nativefrontend/budgets.tsv — the interpreter's MATERIALIZATION BUDGETS as the
# frontend reads them (BUG-078; F2 of the 2026-10-13 fresh-eyes fail-closed pass).
# ONE source of truth for the numbers outside Lean: the frontend embeds this file
# (budgets.go, //go:embed) and NEVER spells the numbers itself; the static lowering
# diagnostic (tools/lowerdiag) reads it at run time under --repo. The Lean definitions
# named in column 3 are the semantic definitions; Tests/GoCoreEval.lean
# (`budgetsTableTests`) reads THIS file and fails unless every row equals its Lean
# constant and the row set is exactly these four — so a re-measured budget moves in
# Lean, the pin test goes red, and this file follows in the same commit.
# Columns: name <TAB> value (decimal) <TAB> the Lean constant it transcribes.
#   arrayLenBudget        per-dimension array length bound (decoder: the array arm)
#   arrayFootprintBudget  nested footprint bound in scalar leaves, also the
#                         constant-count make bound (checkMakeFootprint) and, in
#                         the core, the RUN-TIME-count make bound (the makeSlice
#                         arm, row 31(d) 2026-10-25; the decoder reads the core's)
#   sliceCapBudget        the machine's make COUNT bound (its own named refusal —
#                         the make precedence: never quarantined by the frontend)
#   maxAllocBytes         gc's makeslice limit (Platform; gc's own panic — the make
#                         precedence: never quarantined by the frontend)
name
arrayLenBudget
arrayFootprintBudget
sliceCapBudget
maxAllocBytes
